messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-8675301 fired: p99 latency spike in eu-west-1 for /generate (SLO burn 7.4% -> 15.2%). Alert group: inference-eu-p99. Count: 98 in last 5m. Auto-escalation enabled.

pagerduty: Incident PD-8675301 created by alerting rule 'latency-p99-eu'. Paging primary oncall. Priority: P1.

Alice Chen: ack'd. I'm primary oncall for EU. jumping in. @Ben @Priya if you see escalations please chime in.

Ben Ortiz: on it. seeing increased tail latencies on model-side hosts (gpu-pool-eu-2). KV cache evictions correlating with spikes.

Priya Singh: logs show a burst of large batched requests from a single customer pool around 12:02 UTC, doubling seq length. Could be hot-keys.

Alice Chen: ok. quick checklist: 1) confirm customer impact 2) try warmup/evict tuning 3) consider autoscale burst. Can someone pull per-region error/latency graph?

Maria Lopez: pulling dashboards — https://dash.company/inference/eu/p99 (posted). p50 steady, p95 slight bump, p99 jumps to ~2.8s from 0.6s. TPS steady.

Samir Patel: correlating PCP (prefix cache) miss rate: spike from 8% -> 46% at same window. KV mem pressure on sidecars at ~92%.

Ben Ortiz: running a quick KV cache eviction threshold increase on staging, will mirror to prod if good. Command: ```kubectl -n infra set env deploy/sidecar CACHE_EVICT_THRESH=0.85```

Priya Singh: also seeing high continuous-batch sizes for few callers. Could throttle heuristics help? We can temporarily lower max_batch_tokens to limit single-request tail.

Alice Chen: do it. Ben, apply the env change to prod sidecars with a 1m rollout. Priya, reduce max_batch_tokens on route /generate -> 4096 to 2048 for eu region.

Ben Ortiz: applied sidecar env to 30% canary. No immediate errors. Observability shows slight drop in evictions for canary hosts.

Priya Singh: updated routing config: `routes.generate.max_batch_tokens=2048` on eu cluster. Rolling changes now.

incident-bot: PD-8675301 update: acked by Alice Chen. Escalation to secondary after 10m if not resolved.

Alice Chen: initial impact: a handful of customer requests experienced 1.5-3s extra latency. No errors increased, so functional but degraded. Customer success notified for high-touch customers in EU.

Maria Lopez: autoscaler panels show negligible new capacity — queries are bursting single hosts not total traffic. Autoscaling won't help immediate tail.

Samir Patel: KV sidecar memory reclaiming slowly. Next step: increase sidecar memory on hot hosts and trigger rolling restart for those nodes. Suggest target hosts: gpu-eu-2a-0..3.

Ben Ortiz: I'll do a rolling restart on the three hottest pods, one at a time. Command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-gpu --selector=hotkey=true` doing pod-0 now.

Priya Singh: while Ben restarts, I'm enabling per-customer rate limiting for the noisy tenant. Temporary cap 10rps.

Alice Chen: good. Also enable fallback routing to smaller-llm-variant for non-critical requests: `route.fallback=llm-small` for eu. Doing that now.

Ben Ortiz: pod-0 restarted cleanly. pod-1 now. Latency on restarted hosts back to baseline for canary.

Maria Lopez: p99 trending down: 15m avg now 1.6s, current 1.2s, still above SLO but improving. SLO burn reduced to 9.1%.

incident-bot: PD-8675301 note: Escalation window extended while acked.

Alice Chen: summary: root cause likely KV cache thrash due to a small set of high-token batched requests causing memory pressure. Mitigations: lowered batch token cap, sidecar evict threshold bump, targeted restarts, tenant rate limit, fallback routing. Continue monitoring 30m.

Priya Singh: will follow up with perf team to propose a longer-term fix (adaptive kv partitioning + hotkey isolation).

Maria Lopez: CS notified customers A,B,C in EU — they reported some slow responses but no failed requests.

Ben Ortiz: no further paging so far. keeping watch.

Alice Chen: handing off to Samir for overnight watch in 20m. Samir you ok to take primary?

Samir Patel: taking handoff. I'll keep an eye on p99 and KV miss rates, escalate back if we hit >12% SLO burn.

incident-bot: PD-8675301 set status: monitoring. Last action timestamps logged.

Alice Chen: thanks team. closing bridge once stable for 30m. :thumbsup:
